abstract: A comprehensive specification for civilization-scale deterministic AI systems, multi-ecosystem federation, and post-quantum governance.

sections.content: Serenie v3.0 establishes a civilization-scale deterministic substrate for multi-ecosystem AI governance, long-horizon continuity, and post-quantum multi-agent coordination under strict CEAP-D4+ invariants. It unifies substrate core invariants with post-quantum Dilithium5/Falcon-1024 cryptography and PLONK/STARK ZKP proof envelopes.
sections.title: 1. Executive Summary

sections.content: Formalizes the 5-strata civilization topology comprising Kernel, Ecosystem, Federation, Mesh, and Governance layers across cluster_alpha.serenie.org, cluster_beta.serenie.org, and ecosystem_gamma.serenie.net.
sections.title: 2. Civilization Architecture & Topology

sections.content: Formalizes civilization invariants CIV_INV_001 through CIV_INV_006. Extends identity triples <TenantID, DomainNamespace, LogicalID>, Merkle-DAG execution journals, and delta state transformations to civilization scale.
sections.title: 3. v3.0 Invariants & Extended Semantics

sections.content: Defines 5 core civilization roles: Orchestrators (coordination), Validators (ZKP verification), Synthesizers (consensus aggregation), Explorers (state discovery), and Guardians (invariant protection).
sections.title: 4. Civilization Model & Core Roles

sections.content: Specifies FED3_INV_001 through FED3_INV_004, cross-civilization routing policy tables, and long-range continuity vectors across 500-year historical horizons.
sections.title: 5. Federation Expansion & Continuity Guarantees

sections.content: Establishes Governance, Synthesis, Exploration, and Protection archetypes with bounded trait adaptation rules under CEAP-D4+ constraints.
sections.title: 6. Personality Taxonomy & Autonomous Evolution

sections.content: Outlines sandbox simulation harness architecture and scenario pack stress-testing across governance crises, personality conflicts, network partition healing, and centuries-scale replay.
sections.title: 7. Simulation Harness & Scenario Pack

sections.content: Proves 100% byte-for-byte state recomputability, referential transparency, and cryptographic auditability across all civilization layers.
